title: Population ageing and neurosurgery-related procedure activity in England, 2012/13 to 2024/25: decomposition and fixed-rate projections to 2039/40 (analysis code)
description: Reproducible Python pipeline and derived data for a national decomposition of recorded neurosurgery-related procedure activity in England (Hospital Episode Statistics OPCS-4 code usage, twelve procedure groups, 2012/13 to 2024/25) into population-size, age-structure and age-specific rate components, with a covariance decomposition of between-group variance and fixed-rate demographic projections to 2039/40 using ONS 2024-based population projections, including the age distribution of the projected change. Upstream NHS England code-usage files are downloaded from a pinned commit and verified by checksum.
